text: pahātabboti . catutthaṃ . [94] yo kho rādha anattā tatra te chando pahātabbo . ko ca rādha anattā . cakkhuṃ kho rādha anattā tatra te chando pahātabbo . rūpā cakkhuviññāṇaṃ cakkhusamphasso yampidaṃ cakkhusamphassapaccayā .pe. mano anattā dhammā manoviññāṇaṃ manosamphasso yampidaṃ manosamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tampi anattā tatra te chando pahātabbo . yo kho rādha anattā tatra te chando
